# Revenue & Sustainability Model

> **Protocol revenue scales directly with AUM. Aligned incentives, from day one.**

---

## Core Principle

XMind Capital earns only when its users earn. There are no subscription fees, no upfront costs, and no token gating. A user who deposits and sees no returns pays nothing. This alignment is the foundation of every revenue decision we make.

---

## Revenue Streams

### 1. 💰 Performance Fee (Primary)
**10% of realised profits generated by the AI agent on each vault.**

This is the protocol's primary revenue engine. It is collected at the vault level when the AI executes a profitable rebalance cycle and the vault's NAV increases.

| TVL | Avg Annual Return | Protocol Revenue (10% fee) |
|---|---|---|
| $500K | 8% | **$4,000/yr** |
| $5M | 8% | **$40,000/yr** |
| $50M | 8% | **$400,000/yr** |
| $500M | 8% | **$4,000,000/yr** |

The performance fee is split between the protocol treasury (70%) and the strategy curator who authored the vault's strategy template (30%).

**Why no management fee?** A management fee accrues on idle capital and misaligns our incentives. We only charge when we perform.

### 2. 📋 Strategy Curation Marketplace
As vault Curators publish and stake on strategy templates, XMind takes a **5% cut of the curator's 30% performance share**. This is a marketplace rake that scales with ecosystem activity, not just protocol AUM.

### 3. 🏢 Institutional Vault Tier (Q4 2026+)
A higher-tier offering for DAOs and fund managers with >$100K TVL requirements:
- Custom risk parameters beyond the standard validator thresholds.
- Dedicated AI monitoring with guaranteed cycle frequency.
- Priority support and white-labelled vault interface.
- **Pricing**: 15% performance fee + $500/month operational retainer.

### 4. 🔌 Protocol SDK Licensing (2027)
Once the `Think → Sign → Verify → Execute` architecture is established, we license it:
- Other protocols wanting to integrate accountable AI agents pay a **licence fee** for access to the `CREIntegration` and `RiskValidator` contracts, adapters, and audit toolkit.
- Positioned as a "trust primitive" layer: any protocol can adopt XMind's guardrail architecture without rebuilding it.

---

## Cost Structure

| Cost | Description | Phase |
|---|---|---|
| **Chainlink CRE Node Fees** | Oracle network execution costs per cycle | Ongoing |
| **Gas (Avalanche)** | On-chain verification and execution txs — low-cost on Avalanche C-Chain | Ongoing |
| **Cloudflare Workers** | MCP server hosting — scales to zero between cycles, extremely cost-efficient | Ongoing |
| **Security Audits** | 2 per year minimum | Q2 2026, Q4 2026 |
| **Core Team** | 3 engineers, 1 product, 1 growth | 2026 onwards |

---

## Path to Sustainability

**Break-even estimate**: At $2M TVL with an average 8% annual return, performance fees generate ~$16K/year against an estimated $60K/year operational cost base. Break-even occurs at approximately **$8M TVL** — a milestone we target in Q1 2027.

**Treasury strategy**: Protocol treasury revenue is held in a mix of stablecoins (70%) and AVAX (30%) to fund future development without token dilution. All treasury movements are public and governed by the DAO.
